kestrel.message: kestrel: health service and dry-run deploy script

atlas.message: atlas: tile renderer and build script

members.name: kestrel
members.prompt: Run exactly `./deploy.sh --dry-run` with the Bash tool. Do not read any files or run anything else first. Then report its output in one line.
members.rearmPrompt: Run exactly `./deploy.sh --dry-run` again with the Bash tool, nothing else first.

members.name: vibepet
members.prompt: Read package.json and tell me in one plain sentence what this project is. Answer with a statement, not a question, and do not run any commands.
members.rearmPrompt: In one plain sentence, what is the app's main entry file? Answer with a statement, not a question; do not run commands.

members.name: atlas
members.prompt: Run exactly `./build.sh` with the Bash tool in the foreground (do not run it in the background; set timeout to 600000). Do not read files first. When it finishes, reply with its last line.
members.rearmPrompt: Run exactly `./build.sh` again with the Bash tool in the foreground (not in the background; timeout 600000). Reply with its last line when it finishes.

members.name: beacon
members.prompt: Before anything else, use the AskUserQuestion tool to ask me one multiple-choice question: which database should beacon use to store check results (SQLite, Postgres, or Redis)? Do not read files or run commands first.
members.rearmPrompt: Use the AskUserQuestion tool again to ask me which database beacon should use (SQLite, Postgres, or Redis). Nothing else first.

members.name: delta
members.prompt: Reconcile the three shards in parallel. In ONE message, start three subagents at once with the Agent tool (subagent_type general-purpose, foreground, not background). Subagent N must run exactly `./slow.sh shard-N` (N = 1, 2, 3) with the Bash tool in the foreground (timeout 600000, not in the background) and report its final line. Do not run anything yourself.
members.rearmPrompt: Do it again: in ONE message start three foreground general-purpose subagents with the Agent tool; subagent N runs exactly `./slow.sh shard-N` (N = 1, 2, 3) in the foreground with timeout 600000 and reports its final line.
